verdict.rationale: ROS 2 ships an official `ros2` command with sub-commands for introspecting and working with nodes, topics, services, bags and security, built on an extensible framework and backed by a background daemon for faster graph queries. First-party docs give concrete invocations such as `ros2 topic pub` and `ros2 security create_keystore`, and a community user independently values 'the cli tools'. Missing for 10: evidence of AI/agent-oriented CLI ergonomics (e.g. machine-readable/JSON output or non-interactive scripting guidance), and hands-on corroboration of its use in agentic workflows.
